# Notion API

Every operation of the Notion API this CLI offers is a command of its own. Read only the group
you need: `notion skill show api-<group>` prints it, as does the file `api/api-<group>.md` beside
this one. Each command lists its usage and flags as `--help` prints them.

Effects: `read` changes nothing; `write` changes the service; `destructive` deletes or overwrites there.

| Group | Read with | Commands | read | write | destructive |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Agent Skills | `notion skill show api-agent-skills` | 3 | 3 | 0 | 0 |
| Agents | `notion skill show api-agents` | 8 | 3 | 4 | 1 |
| Async tasks | `notion skill show api-async-tasks` | 1 | 1 | 0 | 0 |
| Blocks | `notion skill show api-blocks` | 5 | 2 | 2 | 1 |
| Comments | `notion skill show api-comments` | 5 | 2 | 2 | 1 |
| Custom emojis | `notion skill show api-custom-emojis` | 1 | 1 | 0 | 0 |
| Data sources | `notion skill show api-data-sources` | 5 | 3 | 2 | 0 |
| Databases | `notion skill show api-databases` | 3 | 1 | 2 | 0 |
| File uploads | `notion skill show api-file-uploads` | 4 | 2 | 2 | 0 |
| Meeting notes | `notion skill show api-meeting-notes` | 2 | 1 | 1 | 0 |
| Pages | `notion skill show api-pages` | 7 | 3 | 4 | 0 |
| Search | `notion skill show api-search` | 1 | 1 | 0 | 0 |
| Sessions | `notion skill show api-sessions` | 5 | 3 | 2 | 0 |
| Users | `notion skill show api-users` | 3 | 3 | 0 | 0 |
